versions.label: v1 · Baseline
versions.note: The baseline proposals branch off. Close to the product, not identical: six proposals have not moved out yet, and two screens follow the spec where the shipped product has an open deviation (B-187, B-191). The changelog's Where column says which is which.

versions.label: v2 · Backup host
versions.note: One named stand-in who can start the Zoom room when the owner is away, the join-before-host guarantee stated under it, and a warning when nobody can start the meeting.
